incidents.title: Missing Columbia Heights Fifth Grader Spotted Inside Texas Detention Center by Classmates
incidents.summary: Nearly a month after a Valley View Elementary fifth grader stopped showing up for class with no word from her family, the missing girl was spotted inside the Dilley Immigration Processing Center in Texas. Two of her schoolmates — brothers in second and fifth grade — recognized her after being released from the same facility. At least seven students from Columbia Heights Public Schools have been detained by ICE, ranging in age from five to seventeen.
incidents.location: Valley View Elementary School / Dilley Immigration Processing Center

incidents.title: Contract Cleaner Detained by Armed Agents in Fraser School Parking Lot (NO NEWS MEDIA)
incidents.summary: Federal agents detained a woman working as a contract cleaner in the parking lot of Fraser School, an inclusive preschool for children with disabilities in Richfield. At least three officers in three unmarked vehicles with tinted windows took the woman from her car, restrained her hands, and drove away.

incidents.title: Federal Agents Present on Richfield Middle School Bus Route
incidents.summary: Richfield Public Schools confirmed federal agents were present on a school bus route on January 30, 2026. Once school staff realized agents were on the route, district leadership traveled to the bus to ensure student safety. Staff and vetted volunteers walked students from the bus to their homes. Superintendent Steven Unowsky confirmed all students were safe and urged students to reach out to school counselors if feeling anxious.

incidents.title: Columbia Heights High School Students Harassed by ICE Agents
incidents.summary: Three Columbia Heights High School students had their cars surrounded by ICE vehicles while lawfully driving to school on the morning of January 29. One 16-year-old student was forced to show their passport to masked federal agents. Another student called the school principal in fear, leaving a voicemail saying agents were "looming around the high school." Superintendent Zena Stenvik reported ICE agents were parked behind the high school in a park and circling schools that morning.

incidents.title: ICE Agents Deploy Tear Gas Outside Minneapolis Preschool
incidents.summary: A video circulating on social media shows ICE agents deploying tear gas outside a Minneapolis preschool on the morning of January 28, 2026. Parents can be heard shouting "This is a preschool! There's kids here!"

incidents.title: Little Canada Elementary Goes to Secure Protocol Due to ICE in Parking Lot
incidents.summary: Little Canada Elementary School in Roseville Area Schools implemented "secure" protocol after ICE agents were observed in vehicles in the school parking lot during school hours. The school locked all entrances while classes continued normally inside.
incidents.location: Little Canada Elementary School, 400 Eli Rd

incidents.title: School Warns ICE Distributing Food Support Flyers (NO NEWS MEDIA)
incidents.summary: The school warning is real, but we don't know if ICE actually distributed flyers. Anne Sullivan STEAM School sent a message on Jan 22, 2026 claiming ICE is distributing food flyers—but no flyer has been produced, no one has described receiving one, and no journalist has confirmed ICE did this. We need: an actual flyer, or anyone who received/saw one.
incidents.location: Anne Sullivan STEAM School, 3100 E 28th St

incidents.title: Border Patrol Commander Greg Bovino Deploys Hexachloroethane Gas Near School at Dismissal
incidents.summary: Border Patrol Commander Greg Bovino deployed gas canisters at Mueller Park, near Ella Baker Global Studies & Humanities Magnet School, just after school dismissal. Video shows Bovino personally throwing the canister. A school bus was forced to drive through the gas while transporting students home.
incidents.location: Mueller Park, near Ella Baker Global Studies & Humanities Magnet School

incidents.title: Five-Year-Old Liam Ramos Detained in Driveway, Allegedly Used as "Bait"
incidents.summary: Liam Conejo Ramos, a 5-year-old kindergartner, was detained by ICE with his father in their family driveway after arriving home from school on January 20, 2026. School officials allege agents used the child as "bait"—instructing him to knock on the front door to see if anyone else was home. Superintendent Zena Stenvik held an emotional press conference asking, "Why detain a 5-year-old? You can't tell me that this child is going to be classified as a violent criminal." Liam and his father were flown to the Dilley detention center in Texas, where they spent 12 days before a federal judge ordered their release.
incidents.latestUpdate: [Immigration judge grants continuance](https://us.cnn.com/2026/02/07/us/liam-conejo-ramos-family-asylum-continuance), postponing the family's asylum hearing and preventing swift deportation.

incidents.title: ICE Agents Near St. Louis Park Daycare Threaten Parent with Pepper Spray
incidents.summary: Two unmarked ICE vehicles were parked directly across from a St. Louis Park daycare parking lot and playground as parents were dropping off children around 9 a.m. When a parent confronted the masked agents, they threatened him with pepper spray. St. Louis Park police responded and the agents left the area.

incidents.title: Man Detained While Driving Sick Wife to Emergency Room
incidents.summary: Liborio Parral Ortiz was detained by ICE agents while driving his wife Bonfilia Sanchez Dominguez to the emergency room for severe back pain. Agents blocked their vehicle before they could reach Mercy Hospital Unity Campus in Fridley. Parral Ortiz was taken into custody and transported to El Paso, Texas within 20 hours—before his family could bring him his diabetes medication. His wife was taken to the hospital by ICE agents, but family members and her attorney were blocked from accessing her bedside.

incidents.title: Hiawatha Academies Student Detained at Bus Stop
incidents.summary: A 12th-grade student at Hiawatha Academies, a public charter school in Minneapolis, was detained by federal immigration agents at a city bus stop around 1 p.m. The detention occurred off campus. The school sent a message to families confirming the incident and began providing dedicated yellow buses for students afraid to ride public transit.

incidents.title: Two St. Paul School Vans Pulled Over by ICE With Students and Teachers Aboard
incidents.summary: Federal ICE agents pulled over two St. Paul Public Schools contract vans while students and staff were on board during the week of January 13-15, 2026. Staff followed district protocols by keeping doors closed and communicating through windows. Both vans were allowed to continue to school without further disruption. The district subsequently announced temporary virtual learning starting January 22.

incidents.title: ICE Conducts Operation Across Street From Aquila Elementary During Dismissal
incidents.summary: On January 14, 2026, ICE agents conducted an enforcement operation at an apartment building directly across the street from Aquila Elementary School in St. Louis Park during dismissal time. Students watched from their classrooms as federal agents kicked down doors. Teachers closed window blinds to prevent children from seeing armed, masked agents. The school district adjusted pickup procedures in response. Over 1,000 community members formed a rapid response group to escort children to and from school.
incidents.location: Aquila Elementary School, St. Louis Park

incidents.title: Students on Transition Plus Bus Witness ICE Fire Rubber Bullets at Man
incidents.summary: On January 14, 2026, students on a Minneapolis Public Schools Transition Plus program bus witnessed ICE agents fire rubber bullets at a Hispanic man after five ICE vehicles blocked the school bus's path. Agents used a fence-type barrier to corral and detain the man. Students were already anxious due to the Roosevelt High School incident on January 8 and the nearby fatal shooting of Renee Good on January 7.

incidents.title: Parent Detained by ICE at School Bus Stop While Waiting with Child
incidents.summary: ICE agents detained the parent of a Northport Elementary School student at a school bus stop in Crystal as they waited with their child. The child witnessed the arrest before safely boarding the school bus. Multiple schools in the area switched to remote learning in response.

incidents.title: High School Student with Legal Status Arrested in Downtown Willmar
incidents.summary: Suban Noor, a 19-year-old Somali woman and 11th-grade student at Willmar Senior High School, was arrested by ICE agents in downtown Willmar while picking up food for her family. She had legal refugee status (Form I-94) and her family had an active Green Card application. The arrest caused approximately 90% of Somali students to miss school the following day. Noor was released five days later on Friday, Jan 17. **Note: This story seems to follow a pattern of Operation PARRIS (Post-Admission Refugee Reverification and Integrity Strengthening) -- see more details on this below.**

incidents.title: Carondelet Catholic School Lockdown During ICE Arrest Outside Building
incidents.summary: Carondelet Catholic School in southwest Minneapolis placed its Upper Campus on lockdown while federal ICE agents made an arrest outside the school building. The school notified parents at 2:44 PM that the lockdown was enacted "out of an abundance of caution." All students and faculty were inside the building and safe.

incidents.title: U.S. Citizen Special Education Teacher Detained for Nearly 12 Hours
incidents.summary: Christina Rank, a 25-year-old special education paraprofessional and U.S. citizen, was detained by ICE for nearly 12 hours after an apparent vehicle collision with a federal agent's car in the parking lot of Concord Education Center, a school serving students with special needs.
incidents.location: Concord Education Center, Inver Grove Heights

incidents.title: 142 Students Absent from Valleyview Elementary Due to ICE Fears
incidents.summary: At Valleyview Elementary School in Bloomington, 142 students did not attend class on Thursday, January 9, 2026. The president of the Bloomington Federation of Teachers attributed the absences to fear of ICE presence near schools following the Roosevelt High School incident and the shooting of Renee Nicole Good.

incidents.title: Fridley Public Schools Closes Twice Due to ICE Activity
incidents.summary: Fridley Public Schools cancelled all classes on January 9, 2026, and again on January 16, 2026, due to ICE activity causing fear and disruption in the community. Superintendent Brenda Lewis cited a major spike in absences and staff availability issues as families made decisions to protect themselves. Approximately one-third of students were absent in the days leading up to the closures.

incidents.title: DHS Subpoenas Hennepin Healthcare Employee Records for 7,000+ Workers
incidents.summary: The Department of Homeland Security issued a subpoena to Hennepin Healthcare on January 8, 2026, demanding I-9 employment verification forms for more than 7,000 employees. The subpoena came less than a week after county commissioners and legislators confronted ICE agents who had shackled a patient at HCMC for 28 hours without a warrant. County Commissioner Angela Conley called the audit a "retaliatory move."

incidents.title: Jesse Ventura Visits Roosevelt High School, Condemns ICE Actions
incidents.summary: Former Minnesota Governor Jesse Ventura, a 1969 graduate of Roosevelt High School, visited the school the day after the Border Patrol incident to show support. Ventura praised the school for "standing up" against ICE and compared federal immigration enforcement tactics to 1930s Germany. He hinted at a potential gubernatorial run, saying "Maybe it's time for Jesse. I only did one term. I'm owed a second."

incidents.title: Daycare Teacher with Work Permit Detained Outside Minneapolis Preschool
incidents.summary: A teacher at Jardin Spanish Immersion Academy was detained by ICE agents in tactical gear as she arrived for work on January 7, 2026. Agents removed her from her car directly outside the Minneapolis daycare. According to a GoFundMe page set up by parents, the teacher had a valid work permit through 2030. Her current whereabouts remain unconfirmed, and she had not been released as of January 16.

incidents.title: Border Patrol Agents at Roosevelt High School, Staffer Detained
incidents.summary: Federal agents descended on Roosevelt High School during dismissal, tackled several people, and deployed chemical irritants. A special education assistant who is a U.S. citizen was detained and later released. Minneapolis Public Schools canceled classes for the rest of the week.

incidents.title: Daycare Teacher Tricked with Fake Car Accident Claim, Detained for 10 Minutes
incidents.summary: A teacher at Un Mundo Nuevo Children's Academy was detained by ICE on January 7, 2026, after being lured outside with a false claim that someone had hit her car. When she went outside to check, ICE agents detained her. The daycare told parents she is "a legal resident of this country." She was released approximately 10 minutes later.

incidents.title: Ten-Year-Old Elizabeth Caisaguano Detained with Mother, Held Nearly One Month in Texas
incidents.summary: Elizabeth Zuna Caisaguano, a 10-year-old fourth grader at Highland Elementary in Columbia Heights, was detained by ICE agents with her mother on January 6, 2026, while on their way to school. During the arrest, Elizabeth called her father to say agents would drop her at school—but neither she nor her mother arrived. By day's end, both had been flown to the Dilley Immigration Processing Center in Texas. Elizabeth spent nearly one month in detention before being released on February 3, making her the first and longest-detained of the Columbia Heights students taken during the Trump administration's immigration crackdown.
incidents.latestUpdate: Elizabeth and her mother [released from Dilley](https://sahanjournal.com/education/columbia-heights-fourth-grader-held-by-ice/) Tuesday evening after nearly one month in detention. They were at a Texas shelter Wednesday morning before returning to Minnesota to reunite with her father.
incidents.location: On way to Highland Elementary School

incidents.title: Patient Shackled to Hospital Bed by ICE for 28 Hours Without Warrant
incidents.summary: ICE agents entered Hennepin County Medical Center's emergency department without a judicial warrant and remained at a patient's bedside for approximately 28 hours. The patient was handcuffed and shackled to their bed despite medical staff objections. Agents were eventually removed after county commissioners and hospital leadership intervened.

incidents.title: ICE Agents Point Weapons at Students During Campus Arrest at Augsburg University
incidents.summary: ICE agents detained undergraduate student Jesus Saucedo-Portillo in Parking Lot B at Augsburg University, a private campus in Minneapolis. University officials said agents pointed weapons at students and staff, including those watching from residence hall windows, and refused to produce a judicial warrant when asked. DHS disputed this account, claiming agents had a warrant and were obstructed by a university administrator.
